response: ["Surgical excision is the first-line management for melanoma.", "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised.", "The excision margin should be narrow (1–3 mm) to perform histological diagnosis.", "For primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness or melanoma in situ, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended.", "Excision margins should be based on tumor thickness.", "If sentinel lymph node biopsy is indicated, it should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should preferably be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision.", "Incisional biopsies may be considered for large lesions on the face, acral areas, or genitalia."]
